title: Orsen and the Alibi
author: M. M. Quintana
blurb: Jonah Montrose, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
